title: Nate Robinson Names Who's House Was The Dopest On House Guest
htmlContent:
Former 13 NBA veteran and Big 3 guard Nate Robinson has a web show on Facebook Watch in partnership with the Player Tribune called House Guest. During numerous episodes, Robinson visits some of your favorite celebrities' homes, and they show him some of their most prized possessions. Some of the celebrities that have been featured on the show are Rick Ross, Tony Hawk, Kerri Welsh Jennings, Von Miller, Tamera 'Ty' Young, and James Johnson. Also during these episodes, the featured celebrities share backstories about how they came across these particular items in their homes for example, in the episode featuring Tamera 'Ty' Young, she talks about how players such as Dwyane Wade and Chris Paul have looked out for her and sent shoes. In the episode featuring Rick Ross, he talks about his car collection, and why he names his car collection. If you ask Nate Robinson, who's house has been the most intriguing and why he probably would say DJ and music producer Steve Aoki.
"He has a lot of cool things in his house that I rate too, art, cartoon characters. For example, Dragon Ball Z, Godzilla, he is also a big fan of Bruce Lee and I am a big fan of Bruce Lee as well. He also has the big trampoline, and pool. I jumped off his 30-foot roof of his house into his pool. So, he has some cool S*** in his crib," Robinson told me. https://www.facebook.com/theplayerstribune/videos/463174491097438/ During Nate Robinson 10 plus years in the NBA he averaged 11.0 points, 2.3 rebounds, and 3.0 assists per game. He also is the only player to capture the Slam Dunk contest crown three-times.
